title: Rawmny Wildcat drops a new single titled “Queen And My Mistress”
htmlContent:
Canadian-based star Rawmny Wildcat is a talented singer and songwriter proving his worth in the music scene as a force to be reckoned with. Rawmny Wildcat shows us what it's like to experience these feelings on the come-up while delivering his recent track "Queen and My Mistress."

Rawmny Wildcat's "Queen And My Mistress" is a conversation between two lovers on how they wish to please each other. "Queen And My Mistress" is a beautiful sonic metaphor for all those going through it. It comes with a Smooth and expressive melody ready for the world to take in and enjoy.
